svg.text: Heresay · eyes on top, but happy
The frown comes from the arch sitting under the eyes. Fixes: more room, a flatter shoulder, happier eyes, a smiling foot.

foreignObject.div: The one you picked. The arch under the eyes reads as a frown.
Eyes lifted and the shoulder lowered, so the arch stops reading as a mouth.
A squarer shoulder has no downturned curve, so there is no frown to see.
The quote eyes tilt up and outward. Upward eyes read hopeful, not cross.
Bigger, rounder quote eyes look wide and friendly.
Closed, smiling eyes (^ ^). Content: the report has been heard.
The leg ends in an upward curl: the whole letter smiles.
The curl and the wide eyes together. The friendliest.
No frown curve at all, a smile at the base, quote eyes on top.
Calm and pleased. The quietest of the happy versions.
